parallel_lineages.summary: OpenRouter API/SETTINGS/CATALOG lineage reconciled by LINEAGE-001; PRs remain historical references only and are never continuation bases.

DOC-004.goal: Canonical project state, token-efficient context routing, local ownership docs, documentation validation and mandatory self-review.

LINEAGE-001.goal: Compare OpenRouter-derived SETTINGS/CATALOG work with the canonical fal line, salvage provider-neutral pieces, rebase deliberately, and retire superseded branches.

SETTINGS-001.note: PR #19 is provider-neutral design/test reference, not a canonical continuation package; re-author as SETTINGS-002 after ACCESS-001.

CATALOG-001.note: PR #20 backend supplies design patterns only; PR #21 UI failed Foundation CI. Re-author provider-neutral catalog for fal as CATALOG-002/CATALOG-UI-002.

ACCESS-001.goal: A-28/AD-09 staff delegation: global scope, finite expiry, fresh auth, audit, self/last-owner guards; permission base for Settings/Catalog.

DOC-004B.goal: Maintenance precision: explicit development base, block-level routing, ambiguity-safe locator, frozen checkpoints, atomic state transitions and semantic local-doc repair.

DOC-004C.goal: Continuation safety: machine-verified next-package branching, CI-to-source evidence binding, dependency gates, stale local-doc cleanup, robust natural-language routing and broader block coverage.

DOC-004D.goal: Final guardrails: strict next-package state transitions, current Accounts map, UTF-8 boundary tests, and routing edge cases.

SETTINGS-002.goal: Re-author the typed basic PlanPolicy preview/publish/history/rollback lifecycle from PR #19 on the canonical fal line, with explicit permission provisioning and no generic key/value or provider settings.

CATALOG-002.goal: Provider-neutral versioned capability/connection/credential metadata for canonical fal and future adapters; reuse safe revision/audit/opaque-secret patterns from PR #20 without OpenRouter literals or replacing the proven Jobs/Fal runtime.

CATALOG-UI-002.goal: Permission-correct admin UI for models/providers/connections/credential metadata; re-author from PR #21 patterns and fix catalog-only navigation/access semantics.

status_meaning.active: The only package a new coding agent may continue by default.
status_meaning.planned_next: Starts only after active package acceptance.
status_meaning.technical_pass: Implementation has technical evidence but may still be unmerged/unreleased.
status_meaning.technical_ci_pass_live_acceptance_pendin: Technical contract is green; real external-provider acceptance remains separate.
status_meaning.parallel_lineage_only: Exists on a non-canonical line and cannot be used as a continuation base without reconciliation.
status_meaning.planned: Not started on the canonical line.
status_meaning.historical_technical_pass: Older technical gate retained for provenance.
status_meaning.historical_implemented_design_unapproved: Implementation existed, but owner design acceptance remains separate.
status_meaning.superseded_reference: Historical non-canonical implementation retained only as review/design evidence; never a continuation base.
